item.title: Crystal Metal Sew-on Buttons
item.description:
Crystal Metal Sew-on Buttons (item 2601037-A) is developed for apparel brands, importers and trim wholesalers. As a one-stop garment accessories platform we confirm size, color, finish and packing against an approved sample. Reference material: Zinc alloy, crystal. Final composition, plating, dimension and inspection are locked after sampling. Typical use: ready-to-wear, knitwear, bridal, scarves and private-label programs.

For a quote send item number, quantity, color or plating, end use and destination. Sampling is handled in Guangzhou. Browse Sew-on Buttons or request a written offer.
